The only academic requirement published is 'A Bachelor's degree of at least 180 ECTS', with no field restriction. The application actively rewards a software background: a compulsory form asks candidates to self-assess their level in mathematics, digital signal processing and computer science, and specifically in JavaScript, Python or C, HTML, real-time graphics programming, geometry, trigonometric functions and algebra. A software-engineering graduate with a music portfolio is close to the ideal applicant profile.
programs.applicationOpens: 2027 CYCLE, CONFIRMED ON THE OFFICIAL PAGE: 'The call for applications for the next DIGICREA cohort 2027-2029 is expected to open in November 2026. Further information regarding this procedure will be available in the autumn. Please note that some requirements will differ from those of the 2026 selection process.'
programs.deadline: 2027-2029 deadline NOT YET PUBLISHED — expected around mid-February 2027, to be confirmed from November 2026. PRIOR CYCLE reference (confirmed on the official page): the 2026-2028 call opened 14 November 2025 and closed 16 February 2026, with Stage II online interviews 24-30 March 2026.
programs.tuitionIntl: ZERO. Confirmed verbatim on the official financial-aid page: 'Students (scholarship holders and non-scholarship holders) are not charged any tuition fees.' Selected self-funded applicants must supply a 'Guarantee of full financial support' with a budget simulation before enrolment, and document income for the visa.
programs.fundingLevel: Full — for EMJM scholarship holders this is a genuinely fully funded option, the only one among the six.
programs.scholarship: CONFIRMED: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master (EMJM) scholarship — €1,400 per month for a total duration of 24 months, maximum €33,600 per student, covering travel, visa, installation and subsistence, paid to the student. A limited number are awarded per cohort. The scholarship application is included within the programme application itself, so there is no separate form. Non-scholarship holders may add Erasmus+ KA131/KA171 mobility funds. Additional support exists for students with long-term physical, mental, intellectual or sensory impairments. Tunisian nationality is no barrier — EMJM scholarships are explicitly open to non-EU applicants.
programs.stipend: €1,400/month for 24 months (€33,600 total) plus zero tuition, for scholarship holders.
programs.facilities: Three-country mobility with a digital-creation environment at each site. At Saint-Étienne the shared CCNT/RIM teaching gives access to a music studio, video studio, multimedia prototyping studio, sensors, interfaces and sound capture/diffusion equipment. Professionals involved in the shared Saint-Étienne teaching include a sound designer at Ubisoft, a developer at Ableton (Berlin) and Cycling'74, the sound engineer running the studios at Le FIL Saint-Étienne, and researchers from INRIA and GRAME Lyon. Porto and Katowice facility inventories UNVERIFIED.
programs.fitNotes: The standout recommendation and the only programme here that clears every one of his constraints at once: zero tuition, €1,400/month for two years, taught in English (so IELTS/TOEFL rather than a French DALF C1), a bachelor in ANY field accepted, a Sound-Music specialization, an application form that explicitly credits his programming skills, and a fully remote selection (one 15-minute online interview). The 2027-2029 call is expected to open November 2026 — precisely his window. Two concrete tasks now: build a portfolio of exactly 3-5 numbered works with public links and metadata (a composition, a sound-design project, a demo, a music cycle), and book an English test at B2 minimum, C1 preferred. Caveats: the curriculum is broad digital creativity — AI, XR, graphic design — rather than a dedicated club-music production course, and EMJM scholarships are highly competitive with only a limited number per cohort.
programs.verificationNotes: Confirmed directly on the official DIGICREA site across three pages: /en/join-digicrea.html, /en/join-digicrea/how-to-apply.html and /en/join-digicrea/financial-aid.html. Confirmed: programme exists and is master level; three-country mobility; English-only instruction; the 180-ECTS bachelor requirement with no field restriction; the exact 3-to-5-work portfolio rule with the 5-year recency limit and 5 MB PDF cap; the 2-minute video presentation replacing the cover letter; the science/technology self-assessment form naming JavaScript, Python/C, HTML; English test thresholds; the two-stage selection with an online 15-minute interview only; zero tuition verbatim; the €1,400/month, 24-month, €33,600 EMJM scholarship; eCandidat as the platform and the explicit exclusion of Études en France; and the November 2026 expected opening of the 2027-2029 call. NOT confirmed: total ECTS figure (not published), the module-by-module curriculum, the number of scholarships per cohort ('a limited number'), and the exact 2027 deadline (not yet set).

programs.program: Master Arts — parcours Création Contemporaine et Nouvelles Technologies (CCNT), option Réalisateur·rice en Informatique Musicale (RIM)
programs.university: Université Jean Monnet Saint-Étienne (UJM), Faculté Arts Lettres Langues — départements Musicologie et Arts plastiques
programs.degree: Master mention Arts, parcours CCNT (second cycle)
programs.durationEcts: 2 years, offered at BOTH M1 and M2 level (this is now confirmed — see verification notes). Total ECTS not stated on the official page; French national masters are 120 ECTS — UNVERIFIED as published.
programs.focus: Electronic Music / Live Electronics + Music Production technology + Sound Design for video games, live performance and cinema
programs.institutionType: Public university
programs.language: French. The official university page lists French as the language of instruction. The programme livret additionally states that courses shared with the EMJM DIGICREA programme are delivered in English — PARTIALLY VERIFIED (livret only, not the main page).
programs.whatYouStudy: The programme combines theoretical research with mastery of advanced electronic and digital technologies for musical and artistic production. Students choose one option: Réalisateur en Informatique Musicale (RIM) or Arts numériques. Teaching is shared between the Arts plastiques and Musicologie departments — described by the university as unique in France — with contributions from many internationally recognised professionals. Max/MSP appears in module descriptions. Dedicated equipment and production spaces are provided across both years: computers, sensors, interfaces, image-capture, sound-capture and diffusion tools, plus a 'studio musical', a 'studio de prise de vue' and a 'studio de maquettage de dispositifs multimédia'. Placements in both M1 and M2. Named RIM career outcomes include work in music production centres, recording studios, theatre, dance, video games and sound design; the wider list includes designer sonore, professeur de MAO, développeur en informatique musicale, and roles at IRCAM, GRM and Centres Nationaux de Création Musicale.
programs.entryRequirements: The official university page confirms the entry level is M1 (start of the programme) but does NOT publish the admission criteria — the livret states only 'CONDITIONS D'ADMISSION — Se référer aux portails monmaster ou ecandidat.' The older RIM-specific documentation (for the M2 route) states entry for holders of a 'Master I en musique, en arts numériques, ou équivalents', or any Master 1 with a demonstrated strong level in musical or digital-arts practice, and expects 'une culture scientifique et une expérience en informatique musicale et/ou en programmation dans le champ des arts numériques'; professionals may enter via VAE. Cohort reported at a maximum of 20 students — UNVERIFIED on the current official page. Programme directors: Laurent Pottier (RIM, laurent.pottier@univ-st-etienne.fr) and Vincent Ciciliato (Arts numériques). Faculty ALL: 04 77 42 13 05.
programs.portfolioSpec: NOT PUBLISHED for M1 entry. For M1 via monmaster the required documents will appear in the mention's 'critères d'examen des candidatures' when the 2027 campaign opens — UNVERIFIED until then. For the M2 RIM route the documented requirement is a dossier from the secretariat or the university site submitted via eCandidat, plus an 'audio commentary' exercise for RIM candidates (an analysis of a musical work) demonstrating artistic/musical competence. He should email laurent.pottier@univ-st-etienne.fr directly to ask what an M1 applicant must submit.
programs.auditionSpec: No instrumental audition. For the M2 RIM route: an interview with a jury of professionals assessing motivation and career project, plus the audio-commentary exercise. For M1 entry via monmaster the selection method is UNVERIFIED. The only dates ever published for the RIM exam route are from a 2018 cycle (application 31 May, admission exams 8 June) — PRIOR CYCLE, long superseded, do not rely on these.
programs.acceptsNonMusic: CHECK — leaning favourable but not proven for M1. Substantively the profile sought is scientific: the RIM documentation asks for 'une culture scientifique et une expérience en informatique musicale et/ou en programmation dans le champ des arts numériques', and accepts 'des étudiants issus d'autres formations ... pouvant justifier d'un bon niveau en pratique musicale et/ou artistique numérique'. So a computer-science background is welcome in principle. What is NOT published anywhere official is the M1 admission criterion — the university page confirms M1 is an entry point but defers entirely to monmaster. He must confirm with the programme director whether a Tunisian BSc in software engineering with a self-built music portfolio is an acceptable M1 dossier.
programs.applicationOpens: PRIOR CYCLE - confirm new date. M1 applications go through monmaster.gouv.fr on the national calendar, which typically opens in late February; M2 applications go through UJM eCandidat. No 2027 dates are published. Monitor monmaster.gouv.fr from January 2027.
programs.deadline: PRIOR CYCLE - confirm new date. No current deadline is published for this programme. The national monmaster M1 window for the 2026-2027 cycle ran roughly late February to late March 2026; the 2027-2028 window will follow the national calendar published in winter 2026-2027. The only programme-specific dates ever found are from a 2018 cycle and must not be used.
programs.tuitionIntl: CORRECTED — the earlier claim of a near-automatic reduction to about €255 is no longer safe. UJM publishes the non-EU differentiated master fee for 2026-2027 as €3,950/yr. UJM's conseil d'administration decided on 8 September 2025 to apply an automatic partial exemption from differentiated fees for international-mobility students enrolled in a UJM national master's diploma; however the €255 reduced figure on that page is explicitly tied to students already enrolled at UJM in 2023-2024 continuing in the same programme, not to new entrants. Crucially, décret n° 2026-385 of 19 May 2026 abolished blanket institutional exemptions and caps discretionary exemptions at 30% of affected students in 2026-2027, 25% in 2027-2028 and 20% from 2028 — so a September 2027 entrant faces a 25% cap. Plan for €3,950/yr plus CVEC (~€105) and treat any reduction as a bonus. Confirm the 2027-2028 UJM policy in spring 2027.
programs.fundingLevel: Partial at best, and now uncertain — no programme stipend, and the fee exemption that previously looked near-automatic is capped and discretionary after décret 2026-385.
programs.scholarship: No programme-specific scholarship found. Two realistic routes: (1) the EMJM DIGICREA at the SAME university, whose €1,400/month scholarship is the funded alternative — apply to both; (2) France Excellence Eiffel, which is nominated BY the institution, pays €1,181/month at master level and carries an age limit of 25 for master candidates. Eiffel internal institutional deadlines for the 2026-2027 cycle fell in October-December 2025 with the Campus France national deadline in early January 2026, so for a September 2027 start he must contact UJM about Eiffel nomination by roughly October 2026. Campus France Tunisie and French Embassy bourses are the other vehicles. UNVERIFIED whether UJM nominates for Eiffel in the Arts mention.
programs.facilities: CONFIRMED on the official page: a dedicated music studio, a video/filming studio and a multimedia prototyping studio, plus computers, sensors, interfaces and capture/diffusion tools available across both years. Teaching staff reported to include Pierre Colomies (sound designer, Ubisoft Montpellier), Emmanuel Jourdan (Ableton Berlin and Cycling'74), Christophe Lebreton (LISILOG), Stéphane Letz (GRAME Lyon), Romain Michon (INRIA), Jérémy Lhuillier (head of studios at Le FIL Saint-Étienne), Michele Tadini (CNSMD Lyon) and Michel Pascal (CNRR Nice) — staff list PARTIALLY VERIFIED, drawn from programme documentation rather than the main university page. Regional partners GRAME and AADN Lyon. Opens onto doctoral study.
programs.fitNotes: Content-wise this is the best match in the whole batch for a programmer who wants to make electronic music: Max/MSP, music computing, sound design for games and live performance, an Ableton developer on the teaching staff, a real music studio, and Ubisoft/GRAME/INRIA connections. The good news from this verification round is that M1 is confirmed as an entry point, so the earlier worry that RIM was M2-only is resolved at programme level. Three live caveats: the M1 admission criteria are simply not published, so he must email Laurent Pottier before committing; instruction is in French, so he needs a DALF/TCF C1-level certificate; and the fee position has worsened — budget €3,950/yr rather than €255. Practical strategy: apply here AND to DIGICREA at the same university in the same season, since a DIGICREA place brings zero tuition plus €33,600.
programs.verificationNotes: Confirmed on the official UJM programme page: the programme exists at master level, the exact parcours and two options (RIM / Arts numériques), 2-year duration, Saint-Étienne, French as language of instruction, entry level M1 (this CORRECTS the earlier ambiguity that RIM might be M2-only), the three dedicated studios quoted verbatim, the RIM career outcomes, and the two programme directors with contact emails. Separately confirmed via a UJM search that the mention is offered at both M1 and M2. Fees verified on UJM's own 'Droits d'inscription différenciés' page: €3,950 for master 2026-2027, with the €255 figure applying to students already enrolled in 2023-2024. Décret n° 2026-385 of 19 May 2026 verified via Légifrance/Sénat sources: caps exemptions at 30% (2026-27), 25% (2027-28), 20% from 2028, and ends blanket institutional exemptions. NOT confirmed: total ECTS, the 20-student cohort cap, M1 admission criteria and required documents, whether a portfolio or audio commentary is required at M1, the 2027 application dates, the English-taught shared DIGICREA courses (livret only), and the detailed staff list.

programs.program: Master Acoustique et musicologie — parcours Ingénierie et conception sonore
programs.university: Aix-Marseille Université (AMU), UFR ALLSH
programs.city: Marseille (Campus Saint-Charles, Espace Yves Mathieu), with some sessions at Aix-en-Provence (Campus Robert Schuman) and CNRS facilities
programs.durationEcts: 2 years / 4 semesters / 120 ECTS (60 per year) — CONFIRMED on the official page
programs.focus: Sound Design + Immersive/Spatial Audio + Recording/Engineering, built on a strong acoustics, perception and signal-processing spine
programs.institutionType: Public university
programs.language: French — C1 minimum for non-native speakers, with a certification less than 2 years old, unless the applicant holds a degree from a French university. English B2 minimum also required. Strong French written and oral expression is explicitly listed as a prerequisite.
programs.whatYouStudy: CONFIRMED module structure. Semester 1 is a common core with the musicology side: Thinking Sound and Music (9 ECTS), Exploring and Creating Sound (9 ECTS), Collective Project (6 ECTS), Professional Development (3 ECTS), Communication (3 ECTS). Semesters 2-3 specialise into Ingénierie et conception sonore: Physical Acoustics (6+3 ECTS), Perception and Cognition (6+3), Signal Processing (3+6), Informatics (3+3), Research and Professional Context (3+3), Sonic and Musical Listening Practices (3), and Collective Projects and Field Schools (6+3 per semester). Semester 4 is a compulsory 5-month internship (24 ECTS) plus the final collective project restitution (6 ECTS). Teaching runs in 9-week blocks followed by 3 weeks of field schools, workshops and seminars; attendance is mandatory and learning is team-based. Internships may be hosted in the PRISM laboratory if places are available.
programs.entryRequirements: Selection on dossier via monmaster.gouv.fr, competitive for both M1 and M2 entry. Requires a Bac+3. Recommended licences CONFIRMED as physics, mathematics, computer science, mechanics, engineering sciences or equivalent STEM backgrounds. The page requires 'solid knowledge in fundamental sciences (physics, mechanics, informatics, mathematics)', a strong academic record in science fundamentals, and an interest in interdisciplinarity combining sound, music and human perception. NEW DETAIL found in verification: musical competency is listed as DESIRED (not required). French C1 certification and English B2. Cohort capacity UNVERIFIED.
programs.portfolioSpec: CONFIRMED ABSENT — no portfolio requirement is published anywhere on the official programme page. Selection is on academic dossier through monmaster.gouv.fr. Since 'musical competency' is listed as desired, it is worth attaching evidence of his own tracks if the monmaster form permits, but whether the form allows attachments is UNVERIFIED until the 2027 'critères d'examen des candidatures' are published.
programs.auditionSpec: None. CONFIRMED ABSENT — no live audition, no on-site test and no interview is mentioned on the official page. Selection appears to be dossier-only.
programs.acceptsNonMusic: YES, explicitly and unusually favourably — re-confirmed in this verification round. The recommended-degree list names computer science and engineering sciences directly, and the page requires 'solid knowledge in fundamental sciences (physics, mechanics, informatics, mathematics)'. The syllabus assumes programming ability (a dedicated Informatics module runs in S2 and S3). Musical competency is 'desired' but not a requirement. This is one of very few French sound masters where a software-engineering BSc is the INTENDED entry profile rather than a tolerated exception.
programs.applicationOpens: PRIOR CYCLE - confirm new date. The national monmaster.gouv.fr M1 campaign typically opens in late February. The only timeline on the programme page is a 2023 cycle: applications 1 March - 3 April, review April-June, admission phase 19 June - 17 July. The 2027 dates will be set by the national monmaster calendar published in winter 2026-2027.
programs.deadline: PRIOR CYCLE - confirm new date. The page shows only the old 2023 indicative window (3 April 2023). The September 2027 deadline will follow the national monmaster.gouv.fr calendar, expected to be announced around January 2027 with a closing date in late March 2027.
programs.tuitionIntl: CORRECTED AND WORSE THAN PREVIOUSLY RECORDED. AMU publishes the non-EU differentiated master fee for 2026-2027 as €3,950/yr. AMU's earlier plan of an automatic 75% partial exemption for nationals of listed countries has been overturned by décret n° 2026-385 of 19 May 2026: the exemption is now discretionary and applied after registration closes, and only 'certains étudiants ayant acquitté la totalité des droits d'inscription différenciés pourront bénéficier d'une exonération partielle à 75%'. Critically, TUNISIA IS NOT on AMU's named priority list — the only nationalities named are Lebanese, Ukrainian and Palestinian. So the working assumption must be €3,950/yr, with a possible reduction to €987.50 only if he is selected in the centralised review. Plus CVEC (~€105). The national exemption cap is 30% of affected students in 2026-2027 and 25% in 2027-2028 — his year.
programs.fundingLevel: None to partial, and materially worse than previously assumed. Assume he pays €3,950/yr unless he wins an external scholarship or is picked in AMU's capped discretionary 75% review.
programs.scholarship: None programme-specific. Realistic vehicles: France Excellence Eiffel (nominated BY the institution, €1,181/month at master level, age limit 25 for master candidates; institutional internal deadlines fell October-December for the 2026-2027 cycle with the Campus France national deadline in early January 2026 — so for September 2027 he must approach AMU's international office around October 2026); Campus France Tunisie and French Embassy bourses; a French government scholarship (BGF) also confers full exemption from differentiated fees. AMU-specific international scholarships UNVERIFIED.
programs.stipend: No programme stipend. Eiffel, if awarded through the university, pays €1,181/month plus an air ticket and social cover.
programs.facilities: Campus Saint-Charles in central Marseille (Espace Yves Mathieu), with some teaching at Aix-en-Provence and at CNRS facilities. Field schools, workshops and seminars in 3-week blocks; collective projects across all semesters; a 5-month internship, potentially in the PRISM laboratory (a CNRS/AMU sound-and-perception lab). Studio, console and immersive-room inventory UNVERIFIED — the page does not publish an equipment list.
programs.fitNotes: Still the best academic 'front door' in France for exactly his degree: the programme asks for a physics/maths/informatique licence, is dossier-only with no audition and no music-theory test, and sits in a major coastal city with a real music scene. Two things changed in verification. First, the fee position is much worse than recorded — Tunisia is not on AMU's priority list and the 75% reduction is now discretionary and capped, so he should budget €3,950/yr. Second, the orientation is confirmed as scientific rather than craft-based: acoustics, perception and cognition, signal processing and informatics dominate, with 'exploring and creating sound' and collective projects carrying the creative load. He will not learn beat-making here; he will learn the physics and code behind sound, then apply it in projects and a 5-month internship. Also note the hard gate of a French C1 certificate less than 2 years old — he is fluent but has no certificate, so a DALF C1 or TCF sitting is a 2026 to-do alongside his English test.
programs.verificationNotes: Confirmed on the official AMU ALLSH page: the programme exists at master level; 2 years / 4 semesters / 120 ECTS (60 per year); Marseille Saint-Charles with Aix-en-Provence and CNRS sessions; French C1 with a certificate less than 2 years old plus English B2; recommended licences including computer science and engineering sciences; the requirement of solid knowledge in physics, mechanics, informatics and mathematics; musical competency listed as desired; the full semester-by-semester module list with ECTS weights; the 9-week block teaching structure with mandatory attendance; the compulsory 5-month S4 internship worth 24 ECTS with a PRISM option; monmaster.gouv.fr as the platform; and the complete ABSENCE of any portfolio or audition requirement. Fees verified separately on AMU's differentiated-fees page: €3,950 for master 2026-2027, Tunisia NOT on the named exemption list (only Lebanon, Ukraine, Palestine), and the 75% partial exemption now discretionary and post-registration following décret n° 2026-385 of 19 May 2026. NOT confirmed: cohort capacity, studio/equipment inventory, whether creative work may be attached to the monmaster dossier, and the 2027 application dates.

programs.program: Master Ingénierie de l'image, ingénierie du son — parcours Image et Son

programs.degree: Master, mention Ingénierie de l'image, ingénierie du son
programs.durationEcts: 2 years (M1 + M2), 4 semesters (S7-S10), 120 ECTS total, 60 per year — CONFIRMED on the official page
programs.focus: Recording/Engineering + Immersive/Spatial Audio + Music Production (studio) + film and AV post-production. Students choose between a Sound/Music track and a Cinema track in semesters 8 and 9.
programs.institutionType: Public university, science faculty; an engineering-oriented image-and-sound school
programs.language: French
programs.whatYouStudy: CONFIRMED sound modules: Electroacoustics & Room Acoustics (S7); Microphones and Loudspeakers (S7); Audio Signal Processing (S7); Sonic Perception (S8); Studio recording, mixing and mastering (S8-S9); Spatialized Sound covering stereo, object-based and binaural formats (S9). Image and post-production courses run alongside across both years. NEW DETAIL confirmed in verification: students choose between a Sound/Music specialisation and a Cinema specialisation in S8-S9, and the practical project is either a short film / sound fiction OR musical recordings with mixing and mastering — i.e. a genuine music-production route exists inside the degree. Internships: minimum 4 weeks in M1, minimum 4 months in M2. Graduates go into audiovisual and cinema (lighting, editing, sound, post-production) and into music careers in recording studios and live events.
programs.entryRequirements: M1: an L3 in the mention Sciences Pour l'Ingénieur, parcours Image & Son, 'ou équivalent', assessed by examination of the application dossier plus an interview; applications via the national monmaster platform. M2: continuation from the M1 Image et Son or an equivalent master, again on dossier plus interview, via UBO eCandidat. Cohort: 'La limitation à 18 étudiants par promotion' — confirmed, 18 students per year, which the page frames as enabling close individual follow-up. The school reports strong professional insertion after the M2.
programs.portfolioSpec: CONFIRMED ABSENT — no portfolio of works is specified on the official page. Selection is 'examen du dossier de candidature et entretien'. The page does not list the dossier contents, so whether personal sound work may be attached is UNVERIFIED. He should email the programme to ask, since a demo reel would be his strongest argument for equivalence.
programs.auditionSpec: No audition. An interview ('entretien') follows the dossier review for BOTH M1 and M2 entry — this is a mandatory part of selection, not an optional add-on. Format (remote or on-site in Brest) and language of the interview are UNVERIFIED; assume French.
programs.acceptsNonMusic: CHECK — leaning yes on subject matter, unproven on procedure. The stated requirement is an L3 in Sciences Pour l'Ingénieur with the Image & Son specialisation 'ou équivalent'. A software-engineering BSc is scientifically adjacent and the master's own spine is signal processing, electroacoustics and audio informatics, so the content fit is real. But the programme is explicitly designed as a continuation of UBO's own L3 Image & Son, and nowhere does the page publish wording accepting a general non-specialised science degree, let alone a foreign one. With only 18 places and internal candidates in the pipeline, a direct M1 entry from a Tunisian CS degree needs a case-by-case ruling. He must email the programme to test eligibility BEFORE the monmaster window opens. Note: no music degree is required — the obstacle is the missing image-and-sound specialisation, not a missing music background.
programs.applicationOpens: PRIOR CYCLE - confirm new date. For the 2026-2027 cycle, M1 applications opened 17 February 2026 on the national monmaster platform, and L3/M2 applications opened 27 April 2026 on UBO eCandidat. The 2027 M1 opening will follow the national monmaster calendar, expected late February 2027.
programs.deadline: PRIOR CYCLE - confirm new date. 2026-2027 reference: the M1 monmaster window ran 17 February - 16 March 2026; the L3/M2 eCandidat window ran 27 April - 31 May 2026. The September 2027 M1 deadline will be set by the national monmaster calendar published in winter 2026-2027 — expect a mid-to-late March 2027 closing.
programs.tuitionIntl: CORRECTED AND WORSE THAN PREVIOUSLY RECORDED. UBO publishes the non-EU differentiated master fee for 2026-2027 as €3,950/yr. programs.scholarship: None programme-specific. programs.facilities: Studio practice in recording, mixing and mastering; spatial audio work across stereo, object-based and binaural formats; electroacoustics, microphones and loudspeakers taught as dedicated modules; a cohort capped at 18 so per-student studio access is high; M1 internship of at least 4 weeks and M2 internship of at least 4 months. Console and room inventory UNVERIFIED — no equipment list is published.
programs.fitNotes: Technically the closest French public master here to a real sound-engineer training, and verification improved the picture on content: the S8-S9 split confirms an explicit Sound/Music track whose practical project can be musical recordings with mixing and mastering, not just film sound. With 18 students per year, studio time should be genuinely available. Three frictions, one of them new. First, entry: the programme is built as a continuation of its own L3 Image & Son, so a direct M1 entry from a Tunisian CS degree needs a case-by-case ruling — send an eligibility email well before February 2027. Second, money: the blanket partial exemption is gone, so this is now a €3,950/yr proposition rather than the near-free option previously assumed. Third, place: Brest is a long way from any electronic-music scene, which matters for someone whose goal is to become a working DJ. If they accept him, the curriculum-to-goal alignment is among the best in this batch; the risk is that they simply do not.
programs.verificationNotes: Confirmed on the official UBO formations page: the programme exists at master level; Brest; French; 2 years, 4 semesters, 120 ECTS at 60 per year; the 18-student-per-cohort cap quoted verbatim; M1 entry from L3 SPI parcours Image & Son 'ou équivalent' via monmaster with dossier plus interview; M2 entry via UBO eCandidat with dossier plus interview; the full sound module list (electroacoustics and room acoustics, microphones and loudspeakers, audio signal processing, sonic perception, studio recording/mixing/mastering, spatialized sound in stereo/object-based/binaural); the S8-S9 choice between a Sound/Music and a Cinema track; the practical project alternative of musical recordings with mixing and mastering; internship minimums of 4 weeks in M1 and 4 months in M2; and the ABSENCE of any portfolio requirement. programs.program: Master Cinéma et audiovisuel — parcours Son (entered via the Master 1 Cinéma & Audiovisuel Parcours Généraliste, then Master 2 Son)
programs.university: Université Toulouse - Jean Jaurès / École Nationale Supérieure d'AudioVisuel (ENSAV)
programs.durationEcts: 2 years. M1 entry requires Bac+3 / 180 ECTS; M2 Son entry requires Bac+4 / 240 ECTS. Programme ECTS total not published — UNVERIFIED (French masters are 120 ECTS).
programs.focus: Film Sound + Sound Design + Recording, practice-based and very production-heavy. This is cinema and audiovisual sound, not music production.
programs.institutionType: Public university film school — école interne of Université Toulouse - Jean Jaurès, described as the first and only national film school located outside Paris
programs.language: French throughout
programs.whatYouStudy: Roughly 15 compulsory exercises across the two years — sound pieces, documentaries and fiction works, each with defined pedagogical constraints — plus a personal film at the end of M1 and of M2 with no restriction on genre or duration, each accompanied by a methodological dissertation. Taught content covers acoustic principles, analogue and digital audio technology, sound recording, editing, mixing and diffusion. CONFIRMED M2 Son exercises specifically: location sound recording (phonography), documentary sound creation, sound post-production, a written audio-technology dissertation, sound design for a visual sequence, collaborative work with the Image and Réalisation M2 students on the 'Filmer le Travail' project, and a final thesis with an accompanying audio or audiovisual product defended before a professional jury.
programs.entryRequirements: IMPORTANT STRUCTURAL CORRECTION. ENSAV does not run a 'parcours Son' from M1. It runs a Master 1 Cinéma & Audiovisuel Parcours Généraliste (alongside M1 Production, REX and XR), and Son is one of seven M2 specialisations (Son, Image, Réalisation, Production, REX, Architecture Décor/VFX, XR). M1 Généraliste entry: 'Licence Création Audiovisuelle ou d'une formation bac+3 équivalente dans les domaines des arts, des arts du spectacle, de l'architecture, du design, des arts plastiques, DE L'INFORMATIQUE ou des beaux-arts', i.e. Bac+3 / 180 ECTS. M2 Son entry: Bac+4 / 240 ECTS, and the ENSAV page states that entrants must have 'already been previously trained in sound basics during the generalist years of Licence and Master 1' at ENSAV. Selection is on dossier, and after the file review 'un entretien peut être programmé avec le candidat'. Dossiers are emailed directly to ensav@univ-tlse2.fr — the Son route is handled by ENSAV itself, not via Mon Master (the Production parcours does use Mon Master). Extra-European applicants are also routed through Études en France. Contact: Djazaira Berkouk, ensav@univ-tlse2.fr, 05 61 50 44 46; ENSAV, 56 rue du Taur, 31000 Toulouse, 05 61 50 35 07.
programs.portfolioSpec: Not published. The application is a downloadable ENSAV dossier form emailed back to the school. For the Production parcours the dossier requires a one-page mémoire project; the equivalent creative requirement for the generalist M1 and for M2 Son — number of works, length, format — is NOT specified on any public page. UNVERIFIED. He must request the current dossier from ensav@univ-tlse2.fr.
programs.auditionSpec: No live audition and no written concours found. Selection is on dossier, with a possible interview after the file review ('un entretien peut être programmé'). Whether the interview is remote or on-site in Toulouse is UNVERIFIED.
programs.acceptsNonMusic: YES for the M1 entry point, and this remains the most explicitly CS-friendly admissions wording found in France: the accepted bachelor list names 'DE L'INFORMATIQUE' outright, so a Bac+3 in computer science is a named, accepted qualification for the Master 1 Généraliste. No music degree, no audition and no music-theory test. BUT — and this is the correction — that acceptance gets him into the GENERALIST M1, not into Son. M2 Son requires Bac+4 and presumes sound training already acquired during ENSAV's own Licence and M1 years, so reaching the Son specialisation means completing the generalist M1 first and then competing internally.

programs.facilities: ENSAV is a public national film school with seven M2 specialisations co-located, so sound students work inside real crews with image, directing, production, VFX and XR students. programs.fitNotes: Verification changed the verdict here. The admissions wording is still the most CS-friendly in France — 'de l'informatique' is a named accepted licence — and the route into the M1 Généraliste is genuinely open to him, dossier plus possible interview, no audition. But Son is not an M1 parcours: it is one of seven M2 specialisations, and ENSAV states that M2 Son entrants are expected to have already acquired sound basics during the school's own Licence and M1 years. So the realistic path is two-step and uncertain: get into the generalist M1, absorb the sound fundamentals there, then compete for one of the M2 Son places. Layered on top: it is cinema sound rather than music production, so it trains a boom operator or re-recording mixer, not a DJ or producer; it is French-language throughout (fine for him, though a C1 certificate will still be asked for); the dossier contents are not public so he must write to ENSAV; and the fee is now €3,950/yr rather than near-free. Good school, wrong craft for his stated goal, and a bottleneck between entry and specialisation.

programs.city: Saint-Denis (La Cité du Cinéma, 20 rue Ampère, 93200), Paris region
programs.degree: Diplôme de niveau Bac+5 conférant le grade de Master (one of the School's three Masters: Photographie, Cinéma, Son)

programs.focus: Recording/Engineering + Film/Game Sound + Sonic Arts + Immersive Audio + some Music Production
programs.institutionType: Public grande école under the Ministère de l'Enseignement supérieur et de la Recherche
programs.language: French. English taught as a subject throughout; the livret states 'Pour tous les Masters, une maîtrise de l'anglais est recommandée.'
programs.whatYouStudy: Year 1 common core on three axes: science/technology (acoustique et électroacoustique, traitement du signal, électronique appliquée); instrumental fundamentals (prise de son, montage et mixage pour le cinéma, music production, radio creation, live-sound technique); project-based productions with the Master Cinéma cohort and outside partners. Years 2-3 = one of three pathways: SON À L'IMAGE (film, documentary, animation, games, VR, object-based mixing), ARTS SONORES (electroacoustic music, installations, spatial audio, interactive systems), INGÉNIERIE SONORE (live reinforcement, system design, venue acoustics). Avid and Merging Technologies post systems; Wwise + Unity for interactive audio. NOTE: detailed module/ECTS grid is not published on the public page.
programs.entryRequirements: CONFIRMED in the Livret de concours 2026: 'L'admission ... s'effectue exclusivement par voie de concours ouvert aux candidat·e·s de nationalité française ou étrangère, âgé·e·s de moins de 27 ans au 31 décembre 2025 inclus' (i.e. <27 on 31 Dec of the year before entry; for the Sept-2027 intake expect <27 at 31 Dec 2026). Baccalauréat or equivalent foreign diploma PLUS either a State-recognised Bac+2 professional diploma/certification, or 'deux années d'études supérieures dans une même formation (Classes Préparatoires aux Grandes Écoles, Universités, BTS…) reconnue par l'État et égales à 120 crédits ECTS'. Foreign candidates need official ENIC-NARIC equivalence attestations for the baccalauréat-level and Bac+2-level diplomas. LANGUAGE: 'Les candidat·e·s titulaires d'un diplôme d'études secondaires (type baccalauréat) non-francophone devront, lors du dépôt du dossier d'inscription, présenter un test de français de niveau DELF B2, ou un diplôme équivalent (TCF niveau 4, DALF, etc.)' — a Tunisian bac requires this. A printed French translation dictionary may be authorised in the exams on request. 'Il n'y a pas de limite du nombre de candidatures.'
programs.portfolioSpec: CONFIRMED. PHASE 1 = dossier emailed to concoursson@ens-louis-lumiere.fr. 2026 cycle: subject released Thu 5 Feb 2026 15:00, dossier due Fri 20 Feb 2026 15:00. Contents verbatim: 'les réponses à des questions relatives au parcours et à la motivation ; une création sonore d'une durée maximale de 3 min en lien avec une thématique imposée ; une analyse comparée à partir de trois extraits de films disponibles en ligne sur une thématique donnée.' Coefficient 1.
programs.auditionSpec: CONFIRMED — no music audition, but two compulsory ON-SITE rounds in Île-de-France. PHASE 2 (written, Fri 10 Apr 2026): 'Épreuve écrite de mathématiques-physique' 1h15 (coef 1) + 'QCM d'électricité-électronique' 1h15 (coef 1); 'Les calculatrices ne sont pas autorisées.' An eliminatory-mark system applies. PHASE 3 (orals, 8-12 June 2026, in person): oral d'écoute et d'analyse, oral de techniques du son, oral de culture générale et de motivation. 'À l'issue de la phase 3, 16 candidat∙e∙s par Master sont déclaré∙e∙s admis∙es' plus a waiting list. programs.acceptsNonMusic: YES — CONFIRMED. No music degree or conservatoire diploma is required; the only condition is 120 ECTS in any State-recognised formation. The livret's own profile of admitted Master Son students is decisive: 'En Master Son, les candidat∙e∙s admis∙es sont majoritairement diplômé∙e∙s de baccalauréats de la filière scientifique et sont essentiellement issu∙e∙s d'études à dominante cinéma-audiovisuel … ou scientifique (classes préparatoires scientifiques, … parcours universitaire en sciences, écoles d'ingénieurs). Les admis∙es possèdent également une solide culture sonore. Pour l'acquérir, un travail personnel est nécessaire. … La pratique d'un instrument n'est pas obligatoire.' A software-engineering BSc is an explicitly recognised route and a real advantage on Phase 2.

programs.degree: Diplôme de La Fémis conférant le grade de Master

programs.focus: Film Sound (production sound, editing, mixing, sound design for cinema)
programs.institutionType: Public national film school (Ministère de la Culture / CNC)
programs.language: French only — CONFIRMED verbatim: 'La maîtrise de la langue française est obligatoire. Les épreuves se déroulent en français, de même que les enseignements dispensés à l'École.'
programs.whatYouStudy: Four-year cinema cursus in the Son department alongside the six other departments (réalisation, scénario, image, montage, décor, production), built around collective film productions. A detailed module list is not published in the concours modalités — UNVERIFIED. The written test syllabus signals the content: cinema culture (films, professions, equipment), 'esthétique sonore et culture musicale', and applied science — powers/roots/logarithms, acoustic units, periodic and sinusoidal motion, Fourier's law, production and propagation of sound (reflection, absorption, diffusion, focusing, refraction, diffraction), microphones/amplifiers/loudspeakers, oscillating circuits, impedance, hearing and loudness (Fechner's law, Bel/Decibel/Phone, Fletcher diagram), DC/AC and Ohm's law. The document adds: 'C'est uniquement la « compréhension », le « principe » des notions énumérées ci-dessus, qui sont pris en compte.'
programs.entryRequirements: CONFIRMED. Nationality: the concours international is open ONLY to nationals of countries outside the EEA, Andorra, Monaco and Switzerland — correct route for a Tunisian; dual nationals of those states must take the concours général. Age: 'Les candidats doivent être âgés de moins de 27 ans au 1er janvier 2026.' Diploma: equivalent of a baccalauréat AND at least two successive validated years of higher education (by equivalence), with certified translations. Alternative 'professionnel' route: under 30 at 1 January, baccalauréat, and at least two years of professional activity 'quel que soit le secteur d'activité'. French: for non-nationals of francophone states, a certificate from a French-government-approved body attesting CEFR B1 minimum, or a higher-education diploma obtained in a francophone cursus. Maximum three attempts across all Fémis concours. AI use is strictly forbidden: 'L'usage de l'I.A. est strictement interdit.'
programs.portfolioSpec: CONFIRMED, 2026 cycle. Four documents uploaded via the candidate space by Thu 12 Feb 2026 12:00, all strictly anonymous (no name in the dossier, audio/video files or credits, on pain of exclusion): (1) 'dossier personnel d'enquête' on one of three imposed themes, max 20 pages — written part max 10 pages (font ≥10, numbered) + visual part max 10 pages, optionally illustrated by a video document max 5 min AND/OR a sound document max 5 min (links on page 1 via an anonymous account); a dossier that does not treat the chosen theme, or treats it as fiction, is not marked and eliminates the candidate; (2) 'note de synthèse' max 1 A4 page; (3) 'lettre de présentation et motivation' max 1 A4 page; (4) 'un portfolio de projets personnels : 3 projets au maximum, sur 8 pages au maximum, au format PDF' — accepted: photos, drawings, screenplay, comics, video (viewing link in the PDF), 'son (via un lien d'écoute indiqué sur le PDF)'; total moving-image or sound running time limited to 3 minutes.
programs.auditionSpec: CONFIRMED. FIRST ROUND, remote by videoconference: film-analysis test (Wed 25 Feb 2026 10:00, 3 hours; extract screened 3 times; candidate records a 5-8 minute spoken analysis; coefficient 1) and DEPARTMENTAL SON tests (24-26 Feb 2026, coefficient 2) — (a) written paper 1h30 on cinema culture, sound aesthetics, musical culture and the science syllabus; (b) oral 30 min: 'Les jurés pourront revenir sur l'épreuve écrite, et interrogeront le ou la candidat·e sur son parcours et ses motivations.' '14 candidats, au maximum, sont déclarés admissibles.' SECOND ROUND: a single public oral interview IN PARIS, max 30 min, coefficient 4, between Mon 15 and Fri 26 June 2026, covering culture, tastes, experience and projects, the earlier tests, and the note de synthèse / motivation letter / portfolio. 'À l'issue de l'épreuve, 7 candidats au maximum peuvent être déclarés admis (ou sur liste d'attente) le jury ayant pris en compte l'équilibre des départements' — 7 places TOTAL across all seven departments.
programs.acceptsNonMusic: YES for the formal diploma requirement — CONFIRMED. Only 'l'équivalent d'un baccalauréat' plus two successive years of higher education in ANY field is required, and the professional route accepts two years of work experience 'quel que soit le secteur d'activité'. No music or audio qualification is demanded, and the science half of the son written paper suits an engineering graduate. BUT the same paper tests cinema culture, sound aesthetics AND musical culture, and the whole concours is cinema-centred — the barrier is cultural and linguistic, not formal.

programs.scholarship: None found from La Fémis for international-concours students. programs.fitNotes: The international concours is designed for exactly his nationality profile, and the diploma requirement is genuinely open to a software-engineering BSc. But everything else is against him: four years, French-only teaching and testing, €32,000 tuition with a solvency declaration required before he would even know if he is admitted, a cinema-culture and musical-culture written paper, and a maximum of 7 admitted per year ACROSS all seven departments. There is no music-production, record-mixing or electronic-music track. This is a prestige self-pay fallback, viable only if the French Embassy in Tunis funds him outright — not a primary target for a DJ/producer goal.

programs.degree: Diplôme de 2e cycle supérieur de Musicien-ingénieur du Son valant grade de Master
programs.durationEcts: 2 years / 120 ECTS — CONFIRMED verbatim: 'La formation de Cycle 2 dure 2 années. Elle correspond à l'acquisition de 120 crédits ECTS.'
programs.focus: Music Production + Recording/Engineering + Immersive/Spatial Audio + Sound Design (option) + live sound
programs.institutionType: Public conservatoire national supérieur (Ministère de la Culture), member of Université PSL
programs.language: French — the admission interviews are explicitly 'Entretiens en français avec le jury'. An 'Anglais : métiers de l'audiovisuel' module (6 ECTS) is compulsory.
programs.whatYouStudy: CONFIRMED module list with ECTS. Two individualised years with a chosen professional specialisation among PRODUCTION MUSICALE, SPECTACLE VIVANT or CRÉATION, under personal tutors. Compulsory: Technologie audio (12), Projets de production / 'Book' (24), Projet de recherche (22), Prise de son classique (9), Prise de son Jazz et musiques actuelles (9), Mixage musiques actuelles (9), Mixage musique acoustique (9), Anglais métiers de l'audiovisuel Part 2 (6), Communication et gestion de projet (4), Stage FSMSI (20), Travaux pratiques FSMSI (0), plus APM-SON modules at 2 ECTS each (droits/réglementation; entreprendre dans les métiers de l'audiovisuel; sécurité, normes et gestion des risques dans le spectacle vivant). Optional 5-ECTS disciplines include Design sonore, Mastering, 'Réalisation et mixage en musiques actuelles', 'Vidéo 360, Audio 3D, nouveaux médias', Réalisation en informatique musicale, Direction artistique, Sonorisation spécialisation, Son à l'image spécialisation, Arrangement (chanson ou jazz), Musique filmée. Compulsory two-month placement with the Conservatoire's audiovisual service. Research themes: Audio 3D, spatialisation et spectacle vivant, réalité augmentée, vidéo 360. Optional joint Licence Musique et Musicologie with Sorbonne Université.
programs.entryRequirements: CONFIRMED and MORE RESTRICTIVE than previously recorded. 'Pas de limite d'âge associée à ce concours.' Two cumulative prerequisites. 1° Pré-requis académique: 'Être titulaire d'une licence (Bac+3) ou d'un bachelor européen délivré par une école d'art ou un établissement d'enseignement supérieur reconnu, DANS UNE MENTION OU UN DOMAINE EN RELATION DIRECTE AVEC LES PRATIQUES PROFESSIONNELLES VISÉES PAR LE MASTER (pratiques liées aux secteurs de l'enregistrement, du spectacle vivant ou de la création musicale). Il peut s'agir : d'une licence pluridisciplinaire en audiovisuel intégrant des formations scientifiques, musicales, techniques et pratiques ; ou de tout diplôme équivalent combinant une solide base théorique et pratique dans les domaines de la production musicale, de l'ingénierie du son, de la réalisation et de la production musicale ou de la direction artistique en enregistrement.' 2° Pré-requis artistique: 'Attester à minima d'une inscription en 3ème cycle spécialisé / C.P.E.S. / cycle menant au D.N.E.M dans un CRD ou CRR français (ou dans un cycle équivalent au sein d'un conservatoire étranger ou d'un établissement privé d'enseignement artistique). Sont exigées une très bonne connaissance du solfège, une bonne culture musicale, des notions d'écriture (harmonie, contrepoint) et d'analyse musicale.' LANGUAGE: admitted non-francophone candidates must present a French-government-approved certificate at CEFR B1 before 30 June preceding first enrolment and B2 before 10 December following first enrolment.
programs.portfolioSpec: CONFIRMED verbatim: 'Les candidat·es devront remettre un portefolio de 3 projets musicaux, sonores et/ou audiovisuels personnels faisant preuve d'une certaine originalité ou créativité ou démontrant simplement d'un certain niveau de maîtrise technique. Ces projets sont libres et peuvent se présenter sous n'importe quelle forme : partition, musique enregistrée, maquette, prise de son, fiction sonore, bande son pour l'image, musique de film, habillage sonore, création vidéo, clip musical audiovisuel, court métrage, séquence vidéo de musique filmée etc. Les projets doivent être accompagnés d'une note explicative détaillant leur mise en œuvre (visées artistiques, choix, contraintes, lieux et outils utilisés) ainsi qu'une évaluation des résultats obtenus. Le·a candidat·e fera ressortir ce qu'iel a mis en œuvre lui·elle-même et comment. Cette note doit être synthétique et ne peut en aucun cas dépasser 3 pages.' Deposited on the Conservatoire's registration platform by midnight 24 May 2026 (2026-27 cycle). Admissibility = 'Étude du book de projets, CV et lettre de motivation de chaque candidat·e'.
programs.auditionSpec: CONFIRMED, all on site in Paris (2026-27 cycle): jury selection of candidates retained for admission 1 June 2026; 'Test oraux de formation musicale (16 juin 2026) et de sciences (17 juin 2026)'; 'Épreuve d'écoute critique à partir d'enregistrements OU épreuve d'analyse comparée à partir de films, vidéos, ou d'extraits tirés du répertoire cinématographique (17 juin)'; 'Entretiens en français avec le jury (les candidat·es devront répondre à des questions précises sur leurs projets personnels transmis avec leur dossier d'inscription, ainsi que sur leurs expériences professionnelles)' on 18-19 June 2026. The oral test in FORMATION MUSICALE is the decisive hurdle. Number of places per year is not published on the official page — UNVERIFIED (third-party sources suggest ~8; not confirmed by the school).
programs.acceptsNonMusic: NO — CHECK, and this is a correction to any earlier reading. The academic prerequisite is NOT open to any scientific or technical bachelor: the licence must be 'dans une mention ou un domaine en relation directe avec les pratiques professionnelles visées par le master (pratiques liées aux secteurs de l'enregistrement, du spectacle vivant ou de la création musicale)'. A pure software-engineering BSc does not satisfy that wording. Separately and cumulatively, the artistic prerequisite requires at minimum enrolment in a 3e cycle spécialisé / C.P.E.S. / DNEM-track cycle at a French CRD/CRR or an equivalent foreign conservatoire, plus 'une très bonne connaissance du solfège … harmonie, contrepoint … analyse musicale', and there is an oral musical-training test. Both gates block him as things stand.

programs.deadline: PRIOR CYCLE - confirm new date. 2026-2027 entry (confirmed on the official page): 'Dates d'inscription : du 12 janvier au 13 avril 2026 sur Internet'; dossier finalised online by 13 April 2026; portfolio deposited by midnight 24 May 2026; admissibility selection 1 June 2026; tests 16-19 June 2026. programs.tuitionIntl: CONFIRMED (2024/2025 published rates, official CNSMDP administrative-formalities page): droits de scolarité €521 + CVEC €103 + médiathèque €15 + optional BDE €5. 'The fee is set by decree by the Ministry of Culture, and may change each academic year.' NO differentiated non-EU tuition is published — the same fee applies to all enrolled students. This corrects an earlier UNVERIFIED entry.
programs.fundingLevel: Partial — very low public fees (~€640/yr all in), no stipend.
programs.scholarship: CONFIRMED from the official 'Bourses et aides' page. Crous social grant: open to non-EU international students only if they have 'lived in France for at least 2 years' with the right residence permit — so NOT available to him on arrival. FNAUAC emergency grant for students under 35 in financial hardship. 'French Government Scholarships' awarded by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, primarily for postgraduate study — this is the Campus France / Embassy route and the only realistic pre-arrival option. Housing aid A.I.E. of €900 for Crous grant holders. Private sponsor-funded study, project and emergency grants exist, amounts unspecified. No named scholarship reserved for non-EU entrants.
programs.stipend: No stipend. Paris living costs at his own expense; the private study grants are hardship top-ups, not a maintenance package.
programs.facilities: Trains 'musicien·nes-réalisateur·trices' in a formation the Conservatoire describes as unique in France. Access to the Conservatoire's centre audiovisuel and to the whole musical life of the institution (orchestras, ensembles, jazz and musiques actuelles departments) as recording material; compulsory two-month placement with the audiovisual service. Research partnerships on Audio 3D, spatialisation et spectacle vivant, réalité augmentée and vidéo 360. Sorbonne Université partnership allowing a joint Licence Musique et Musicologie.
programs.fitNotes: Curriculum-wise this is the single closest match in France to what he actually wants — prise de son classique/jazz/musiques actuelles, mixage musiques actuelles, mastering, design sonore, Audio 3D and a production 'Book' — at ~€640 a year and with no age limit. But verification makes the blocker harder than previously thought: BOTH prerequisites exclude him. His licence is not in a field 'en relation directe' with recording, live performance or musical creation, AND he cannot attest to enrolment in a conservatoire 3e cycle spécialisé / CPES / DNEM cycle, nor to solfège, harmony, counterpoint and musical analysis at that level, with an oral formation-musicale test to pass. For a September 2027 intake this is effectively closed. It only becomes realistic after several years of formal conservatoire music training — worth keeping as a long-term goal, not a 2027 application.

programs.program: Master Composition électroacoustique (diplôme de 2e cycle supérieur, Métiers de la création musicale)
programs.university: Conservatoire national supérieur de musique et de danse de Lyon (CNSMD Lyon)
programs.degree: Diplôme de 2e cycle supérieur valant grade de Master. CONFIRMED caveat: by arrêtés of 22 July 2021 and 16 June 2023 the master grade is conferred 'Until 2026–27 for Performance, Professions of Musical Creation and Pedagogy (Music) degrees awarded by the CNSMD Lyon' — the conferral for this mention is currently only guaranteed through 2026-27 and must be renewed. Check this before committing to a Sept-2027 start.
programs.durationEcts: 2 years / 4 semesters full-time / 120 ECTS — CONFIRMED: 'The duration of study is four semesters (full-time) … this duration may not be shortened' and 'The acquisition of 120 ECTS … is required'.
programs.focus: Electronic Music / Live Electronics / Electroacoustic Composition (practice-based, studio-centred)
programs.institutionType: Public conservatoire national supérieur (Ministère de la Culture)
programs.language: French. The curriculum includes a modern-language module (SU3, 'Living Languages'). No English-taught pathway found — UNVERIFIED whether English-medium study is possible.
programs.whatYouStudy: CONFIRMED. Electroacoustic music is the main discipline from bachelor entry through the Master. 'The term electroacoustic is used with full awareness of the breadth of its meaning — it encompasses a range of approaches and objectives in the field of electronic music, be it accompanied by visual media, theatrical elements, lighting, or none of these. All forms are welcome.' 'Your curriculum will comprise daily work in the studio, making dealing with recorded material second nature. There is no predefined path of study; rather, the creative projects of each student define the curriculum.' Four Study Units: SU1 core discipline (composition); SU2 related subjects plus one additional subject relevant to the Master's research project; SU3 living languages, professional-integration workshops, applied research methodology, Master's thesis; SU4 opening subjects, 'custom build your own curriculum from the more [than] 100 courses on offer'. Annual participation in the Empreintes new-works festival; 'Voice and Poetry, Text and Music' course with ENS and CERC; collaborations with ENSBA Lyon and ENSATT; work with orchestras and instrumental ensembles; the CNSMD Lyon Improvisation Collective; optional add-on Diplôme d'État and/or Certificat d'Aptitude in music theory or composition.
programs.entryRequirements: CONFIRMED and restrictive. 'Candidates must be between 16 and 30 years of age.' External candidates: 'Non-graduates of the CNSMD Lyon wishing to enter a Master's (2e cycle) programme must hold a Bachelor's, DNSPM, or equivalent degree from a French or international tertiary education institution IN THE RELEVANT DISCIPLINE. Admission is based on a submitted dossier.' Study is full time with mandatory attendance. (The French pages, which also carry a three-attempt limit on the concours in a given discipline, returned HTTP 403 to automated fetching and could not be re-read directly — treat the attempt-limit detail as UNVERIFIED.)
programs.portfolioSpec: UNVERIFIED — still not published. Admissibility is on dossier via the Cadence platform, with a 'Projet de recherche master' form and a 'Déclaration sur l'honneur' among the downloads on the programme page (the versions currently linked are the 2025-concours forms). The exact number, length and format of works to submit for composition électroacoustique appear only in the yearly 'Programme de l'épreuve', which is released on the day registration opens. The page currently links 'Programme de l'épreuve - concours 2025' and 'Annales des concours d'entrée'.
programs.auditionSpec: Two stages: admissibility on dossier, then on-site admission tests in Lyon whose programme is published only when registration opens. Exact test format for électroacoustique UNVERIFIED. Past-paper annales are downloadable from the school site.
programs.acceptsNonMusic: NO — CONFIRMED as a hard blocker. The published external-candidate rule requires a Bachelor's, DNSPM or equivalent 'in the relevant discipline'. A BSc in software engineering is not a degree in electroacoustic composition, so a Tunisian CS graduate would very likely be ruled inadmissible at the dossier stage. He would first need a DNSPM, a music licence, or a DEM-level electroacoustic qualification. Ask the concours office in writing before spending anything on this.
programs.applicationOpens: PRIOR CYCLE - confirm new date. The concours calendar is published annually in November on the CNSMD Lyon site, so the 2027 calendar should appear around November 2026. Only 2025/2026 material is currently online.
programs.deadline: PRIOR CYCLE - confirm new date. No 2027 dates published as of July 2026. Registration and document upload are both done on the Cadence platform; late requests are not accepted.
programs.tuitionIntl: CONFIRMED (official 'Study Costs' page): Tuition €529 + CVEC €103 + Media Library €23. 'CROUS scholarship holders are exempt from the entrance exam fee and tuition fees. CROUS scholarships must be applied for before May to be effective for the following academic year.' No differentiated non-EU rate is published. This corrects a prior UNVERIFIED entry. Living costs published by the school: CNSMD residence €216-€359/month (2023-24), university residence €240-€404; canteen meals €3.35 (€1 for CROUS holders); TCL Campus transport pass €25/month.
programs.fundingLevel: Partial — low public fees (~€655/yr all in), no entry stipend for a non-EU degree-seeking student.
programs.scholarship: CONFIRMED list, and none of it is an entry scholarship for a Tunisian first-year. CROUS social scholarship (needs-based, French residency conditions apply). CAF housing assistance. Université de Lyon aid portal. CNSMD Lyon Student Support Fund — emergency only, patron-funded. Project scholarships: Adami (for performers who already hold a master's or DNSPD, within two years of graduating), Fondation d'Entreprise Société Générale (mainly for musicians in the final stages of study, master's level, funding competitions/academies/travel), and Nguyen-Thien Dao — Fondation Roi Baudouin (open to the whole student body, for projects on cultural fusion, notably Asian influences). All are for enrolled students' projects, not for gaining admission or covering living costs from day one.
programs.stipend: None at entry. UNVERIFIED whether any of the patron-funded project grants could support a first-year non-EU student.
programs.facilities: Dedicated daily electroacoustic studio practice; Espace Transversal de Création (the department hosting this master, head Jean Geoffroy); principal teaching in electroacoustic composition; Empreintes and What'Sup festivals; the Improvisation Collective; collaborations with ENSBA Lyon (art school) and ENSATT (theatre school), plus orchestras and ensembles; over 100 elective courses; onward routes to Diplôme d'État / Certificat d'Aptitude. Nadia Boulanger library.
programs.fitNotes: Artistically among the most attractive electronic-music masters in France — individual composition projects define the curriculum, the definition of 'electronic music' is explicitly open, studio practice is daily, and the total cost is about €655 a year. Two hard blocks for him: the external-candidate rule requiring a bachelor's 'in the relevant discipline', and the 16-30 age band (fine now, but it constrains any two-step plan). Realistically closed for September 2027. A credible route would be a French university master in electroacoustic composition or musical computing first, then this. Also verify the master-grade conferral, which the school's own page currently states only through 2026-27.

Confirmed on that page: programme exists at master level, 2 years / 4 semesters / 120 ECTS, department and head, the open definition of electroacoustic/electronic music, daily studio practice and project-defined curriculum, the four Study Units, the 16-30 age band, the external-candidate rule requiring a degree 'in the relevant discipline', dossier-based admissibility, the master-grade arrêtés with the 'until 2026-27' limitation, and the fact that only the 2025 concours programme and forms are currently posted. Tuition and funding confirmed on the official Study Costs page (€529 + €103 CVEC + €23 media library; CROUS exemption; Adami / Société Générale / Nguyen-Thien Dao project scholarships). NOT confirmed: portfolio specification (published only when registration opens), exact admission-test format, the three-attempt limit, any 2027 dates, and whether an English-taught option exists.

programs.program: Parcours Conception son — Diplôme Arts et Techniques du Théâtre

programs.degree: Diplôme Arts et Techniques du Théâtre conférant grade de Master
programs.durationEcts: 3 years full-time, of which one is a preparatory year — CONFIRMED: 'Formation initiale en trois années dont une année préparatoire', 'Accessible sur concours à partir de Bac + 2 – Cursus de 3 ans'. Entry at 120 ECTS. Total programme ECTS not published — UNVERIFIED.
programs.focus: Sound Design for live performance / theatre + Live Electronics + Sound Engineering (régie, ingénierie, création)
programs.institutionType: Public grande école (Ministère de la Culture)
programs.language: French. CONFIRMED: foreign nationals other than nationals of the listed francophone states must supply 'Un Diplôme Approfondi en langue française (DALF) niveau C1 du cadre européen commun de référence pour les langues, ou un diplôme équivalent (TCF, DALF etc.)'. The exempt list is: Belgique, Bénin, Burkina Faso, Burundi, Cameroun, Canada, Comores, Congo, Côte d'Ivoire, Djibouti, Gabon, Guinée-Conakry, Guinée équatoriale, Haïti, Luxembourg, Madagascar, Maurice, Monaco, Niger, République centrafricaine, RDC, Rwanda, Sénégal, Seychelles, Suisse, Tchad, Togo, Vanuatu. TUNISIA IS NOT ON THE LIST — DALF C1 is required.
programs.whatYouStudy: Three years covering physical acoustics, sound technologies and practices, and the aesthetics of artistic projects, training students for 'des postes de régie, d'ingénierie ou de création, seul ou en encadrement d'équipe', becoming 'l'interlocuteur privilégié dans son domaine qui guide techniquement et artistiquement la mise en scène'. A Master-level mémoire is written — the prerequisites ask for 'Qualités rédactionnelles (en vue de la rédaction d'un mémoire de niveau Master)'. Cross-disciplinary work with the other nine ENSATT parcours (Jeu, Administration du spectacle vivant, Atelier costume, Conception costume, Conception lumière, Direction technique, Écriture dramatique, Scénographie, Mise en scène) on shared productions. A 'Grille pédagogique 2026-27' is downloadable. NOTE: the programme page carries 'Attention : page de formation en cours de mise à jour' — the detailed module list is UNVERIFIED.
programs.entryRequirements: CONFIRMED from the official fiche concours. Age: minimum 18 at 1 September of the entry year, 'sans dérogation possible' and, per the concours page, 'sans limite d'âge maximum'. Diplomas: 'Etre titulaires du baccalauréat ou d'une équivalence' AND 'Justifier d'au moins 2 années d'études supérieures et être détenteurs de 120 crédits ECTS … délivrés dans le cadre d'une formation reconnue par l'Etat'. Foreign nationals outside the francophone list must supply their most recent diploma translated into French by a sworn translator (or a plurilingual version) plus DALF C1 or equivalent. 'Aucune demande de dérogation ne sera possible.' Connaissances souhaitées: 'Mathématiques, Physique : niveau minimum requis BAC + 1 scientifique' — published syllabus covers integral calculus, linear ODEs of 1st and 2nd order, complex numbers and De Moivre, log/exp/power functions, Taylor expansions, derivatives, binary arithmetic and 'Notion de programmation algorithmique'; physics covers electricity and electromagnetism (Ohm, Kirchhoff, superposition, Thévenin/Norton, capacitors, Laplace, Faraday, Lenz, impedance/admittance), mechanics, damped and forced oscillators, resonance, bandwidth, Q factor, and travelling/standing waves with interference. Also: writing ability; broad general, literary, contemporary-art (photo, plastic arts, cinema, music) and theatre culture; ability to work collectively; 'Toute expérience vécue en milieu professionnel, au sens large, est souhaitée'. Three recommended books: Daniel Deshays 'Pour une écriture du son'; Larrue & Mervant-Roux 'Le son du théâtre XIXe-XXIe siècle'; Yann Paranthoën 'Propos d'un tailleur de sons'. A candidature-review commission decides who is authorised to compete at all.
programs.portfolioSpec: CONFIRMED format, but the SUBJECT CHANGES EACH YEAR — the 2027 subject is not yet published. Admissibilité 1 = 'Dossier de recherche : projet de réalisation sonore sur un thème donné'. The 2026 brief was: 'Vous réaliserez, à partir de sons que vous aurez enregistrés vous-même, une courte séquence sans musique ni parole ni texte dont le sujet sera (au choix) : Le portrait sonore d'un espace naturel que vous avez visité (mer, forêt, lac, montagne...) OU Le portrait sonore d'une promenade nocturne que vous avez effectuée' — 'Cette courte séquence devra rester compréhensible par l'auditeur·ice.' Deliverables (stable across years): (1) 'Un document sonore, ne dépassant pas 3 minutes, au format WAV ou AIFF (format compressé refusé). La réalisation sera structurée par la prise de son, le montage et le mixage effectués avec les moyens dont dispose le/la candidat(e), même rudimentaires'; (2) 'Un texte au format PDF justifiant la démarche de réflexion, de conception et de réalisation ne dépassant pas 6 pages dactylographiées de format A4'. Both uploaded via francetransfert.numerique.gouv.fr to concours@ensatt.fr, files named CONCOURS_NOM_INITIALE_NUMERO (e.g. SON_DUPONT_P_55298157). Only dossiers from candidates authorised to compete are examined.
programs.auditionSpec: CONFIRMED. No music audition. Admissibilité 2, ON SITE at ENSATT Lyon: 'Une épreuve écrite de physique (durée 2h00 ; coefficient 1)' and 'Une épreuve écrite d'analyse de textes et/ou de documents audiovisuels (durée 1h30 ; coefficient 1)'. Admission: 'Un entretien avec le jury portant notamment sur le CV, les motivations du candidat ou de la candidate et les épreuves d'admissibilité (durée : 20 minutes environ)'. 'Nombre de places maximum : 6.'
programs.acceptsNonMusic: YES — CONFIRMED and unusually favourable. No music, audio or artistic diploma is required: only the baccalauréat plus 2 years of higher education totalling 120 ECTS in a State-recognised formation. The desired knowledge is explicitly scientific at Bac+1 level in maths and physics, and the published maths syllabus even lists 'Arithmétique binaire. Notion de programmation algorithmique.' A software-engineering BSc over-satisfies both the credit requirement and the maths/physics expectation. The genuine filters are the self-recorded 3-minute sound portrait, the theatre/contemporary-art culture expected, the DALF C1, and 6 places.
programs.applicationOpens: 2027 CYCLE — TWO OFFICIAL PAGES DISAGREE, CONFIRM WITH THE SCHOOL. programs.facilities: France's national theatre arts-and-techniques school; ten parcours trained together on shared productions, so the sound designer works directly with directors, scenographers, lighting designers and actors on real stagings. Collaboration links with CNSMD Lyon. A 'Grille pédagogique 2026-27' is downloadable. Detailed studio/equipment inventory UNVERIFIED — the programme page is flagged 'en cours de mise à jour'.
programs.fitNotes: The most actionable target in this slice. Entry needs only 120 ECTS plus Bac+1 scientific maths and physics — which his degree covers outright, down to the algorithmic-programming line in the syllabus — fees are €605 a year, the test dates for the September 2027 intake are already published, and the portfolio brief is explicitly forgiving about equipment ('même rudimentaires'), so he can produce it on a laptop. Three real obstacles: DALF C1 must be certified (Tunisia is not exempt — book it early); only 6 places exist; and the whole concours assumes theatre and contemporary-art culture he does not yet have, with three recommended books to work through. Content mismatch remains: he would emerge an excellent theatre sound designer and live-sound engineer, with electronic-music production as a side benefit rather than the core — and the 3-year, prep-year-first structure means graduating in 2030.
programs.verificationNotes: Programme page read directly (degree, 3-year cursus with preparatory year, Bac+2 entry, €500 + €105 fees for 2026/2027, €95 concours fee for 2027, full 2027 test calendar, 'page de formation en cours de mise à jour').
